name: Blind spots

subjectOf.text: A corporation that lacks diversity and allows group thinking will struggle to identify issues because it needs a fresh perspective, which harms the corporation long term by reducing its ability to identify its own strengths and weaknesses.
subjectOf.abstract: Similarly, if a corporation lacks diversity and allows group thinking, the board will likely struggle to identify issues because the corporation needs a fresh perspective.77 This can harm the corporation in the long term as it is less able to identify strengths and weaknesses.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Technology and Race in Corporate America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3071378
scope_conditions: boards and corporations without diverse membership

subjectOf.text: Centralized AI structures for monitoring AI agents create a self referential loop that is prone to systemic biases and blind spots, and their rigidity prevents adaptation to the dynamic nature of AI.
subjectOf.abstract: Centralized AI structures for AI agent monitoring create a self-referential loop prone to systemic biases and blind spots, while their rigidity fails to adapt to AI's dynamic nature.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: centralized AI systems used to supervise AI agents
